profile.title: Profile
profile.previewHint: Your display name and user tag appear with your content and in your campaigns.
profile.displayNameHint: This is how the others see you in your campaigns.
profile.userTagHint: Others find you by it, for example for invitations. It can't be changed.
profile.timezoneHint: For dates and times in the app.
profile.reducedMotionHint: Animations are skipped and content appears at once. Applies on top of your device setting.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.intro: Adjust how readable the app is. These settings apply on every device you are signed in on.
appearance.fontScaleHint: Makes all text in the app larger or smaller; spacing and layout stay the same.
appearance.previewText: The mist over Grauhafen lifts as the party reaches the north gate.
appearance.sidebarCollapsedHint: Applies on larger screens. The button at the bottom of the sidebar changes it too.
